basic.label: Tree
basic.note: A tree has roots, a trunk and branches.

basic.label: Leaf
basic.note: A leaf uses sunlight to help the plant make food.

basic.label: Trunk
basic.note: The trunk holds the branches up.

basic.label: Root
basic.note: Roots take up water from the soil.

basic.label: Flower
basic.note: Some flowers grow into fruit after pollination.

basic.label: Apple
basic.note: An apple holds seeds inside its core.

advanced.label: Acorn
advanced.note: An acorn is the seed of an oak tree.

advanced.label: Pine tree
advanced.note: A pine tree has needles instead of broad leaves.

advanced.label: Fallen leaf
advanced.note: A fallen leaf breaks down on the ground.

advanced.label: Maple leaf
advanced.note: A maple leaf has several pointed lobes.

advanced.label: Bark
advanced.note: Bark covers the outside of the trunk.

advanced.label: Branch
advanced.note: A branch grows out from the trunk.

advanced.label: Bud
advanced.note: A bud can open into a leaf or flower.

advanced.label: Seedling
advanced.note: A seedling is a young plant that has sprouted.
